  [Category.{v₂, u₂} D] (S : C ⥤ D) (T : D) : Type (max u₁ v₂)

***

has as its objects `D`-morphisms of the form `S Y ⟶ T`, for some `Y : C`,
and morphisms `C`-morphisms `Y ⟶ Y'` making the obvious triangle commute.
